locations.name: Museum Voorlinden
locations.description: Modern and contemporary art museum on the Voorlinden estate

locations.name: Royal Eise Eisinga Planetarium
locations.description: UNESCO site, oldest working planetarium (1781), built into a living-room ceiling. Pre-booked time slot required and no Museumkaart. €6.50/€5.00

locations.name: Molen De Onderneming
locations.description: Thatched octagonal stellingmolen from 1850, Rijksmonument, volunteer-run grain and barley mill. Worth the walk out from the village even if it is shut

locations.name: Nice Flavour
locations.description: Eetcafé, cafetaria and pizza in one, and the only place in the village for an evening meal. Three awards at the Nederlandse Horecaprijzen

locations.name: Kazemattenmuseum Kornwerderzand
locations.description: Bunkers of the 1940 Kornwerderzand defence line, where Dutch troops held off the German advance. Shut for winterstop from 1 Dec, but group visits still run by appointment. Free with Museumkaart

locations.name: Sluisweg & Steiger Kornwerderzand
locations.description: Walk out along the sluices to the pier, past the casemates and the free Vismigratierivier viewpoint. The 4 km path on to Zurich is reachable from the Frisian side; crossing the whole dijk is not, as the fietsbus stops 1 Nov to 1 Mar

locations.name: Willemshaven & pier
locations.description: Park here and walk the quays out to the pier for a view over the Wadden Sea, with the Vlieland ferries and fishing fleet passing. Lightship Jenni Baynton, the 11Fountains sperm-whale fountain, and the old lighthouse nearby

locations.name: Havenbrouwerij Het Brouwdok
locations.description: Harbour brewery in the Willemshaven, a short walk along the quays from the pier

locations.name: Bolsward town walk
locations.description: Longest of the four, 4.1 km, from the 1615 town hall that is now the VVV and Museum De Tiid. Past the burnt-out Broerekerk under its glass roof and the Vleermuis fountain. Free parking at Plein 1455, €3 route

locations.name: Us Heit, De Friese Bierbrouwerij
locations.description: Family brewery, eight beers plus Frysk Hynder whisky, small museum of old equipment and a terrace by the hop garden. Winter proeflokaal is Saturday afternoon only. Tour at 14:30, reserve 24 h ahead: €14.50, or €34.50 with a tasting

locations.name: Rederij Doeksen ferry terminal
locations.description: Departures to both Vlieland and Terschelling: 2 h ferry or 50 min fast service. Winter Dagkaart €28.00 adult, €16.00 child 4-11. The car park under the terminal is steep; P1 Tsjerk Hiddes is cheaper, about 10 min walk

locations.name: West-Terschelling harbour
locations.description: Where the ferry lands. No permit needed to bring a car, unlike Vlieland, but a winter return runs about €205 and excludes passengers, so go on foot and use the island bus

locations.name: Zeehondentocht WadExperience
locations.description: RIB out to the sandbanks between Terschelling and Vlieland, 45 min, €29.50 adult and €22.50 child 5-12. Grey seals pup here in midwinter. Needs 5 aboard to sail, so book ahead. Low water is best

locations.name: Eetcafé Storm & Brouwerij Schoemrakker
locations.description: Proeflokaal of Schoemrakker, the island brewery behind it at the foot of the Brandaris, with all its beers on tap. No tours at present

locations.name: Veerdam Oost-Vlieland
locations.description: Where the ferry lands, walking distance from the village, with a bus meeting the boat and bike rental on the harbour. Car-free island: bringing one needs a T-ontheffing from the municipality. Reservation is mandatory for all passengers

locations.name: Vliehors Expres
locations.description: Two hours by bus across the Vliehors, the island's western 20 km² of sandflat, with seals at the point and a stop at the Drenkelingenhuisje, a wreck survivors' refuge now a beachcombers' museum. Winter boarding from the beach at 't Badhuys

locations.name: Grutte Pier Brouwerij
locations.description: Taste among the kettles and barrels, or outside by the water at a wood fire. Proefzwaard of four glasses €13.75, tour with tasting from €12.50. Walk-ins welcome. Games inside, go-karts and swings in the yard. Sat and Sun 14:00-20:00 only

locations.name: Jopie Huisman Museum
locations.description: Rag-and-bone man who painted what passed through his hands: worn boots, patched trousers, scrap, the people of Workum. He refused to sell most of it, so the collection stayed here. Free with Museumkaart

locations.name: Uitkijkpunt Hokje Bakker
locations.description: Steel plateau in the middle of the Warkumerwaard. Thousands of geese in winter, plus Bewick's swans and great egrets, so bring binoculars. Free verge parking at the plateau makes the 3 km lane optional. Google Maps calls it Uitkijkpunt IJsselmeer. No dogs

locations.name: Uitkijkpunt It Soal
locations.description: Plateau over the Warkumerwaard, which is closed to the public, so viewpoints are the only way in. Ducks and geese in winter. Hard surface throughout: park just before camping It Soal, past the surf school to the beach, then right. Paid. No dogs

locations.name: Hindeloopen town walk
locations.description: Second smallest of the eleven cities and a protected townscape, so the centre is the sight. 2.5 km signposted from the hand-worked 17th-century lock and its drawbridge. Free parking outside the centre, €3 route at the museum

locations.name: Nieuwjaarsduik Lemmer
locations.description: Official Unox duik off the Baai van Lemmer, early afternoon, with sign-up at the Beachclub an hour before. Changing rooms and hot showers at zwembad Ny Sudersé, snert after

locations.name: Nieuwjaarsduik Hindeloopen
locations.description: Into the IJsselmeer from the old harbour, early afternoon, with the borrel in Café de Boekanier after

locations.name: De Hinde
locations.description: On the old harbour, Michelin-listed for regional cooking at €€. Own kitchen garden, house-smoked IJsselmeer eel, game in winter. Winter lunch only, 12:00-17:00, but daily from 18 Dec to 3 Jan. The 11:00-21:00 listed online is summer hours

locations.name: Sloten town walk
locations.description: Smallest of the eleven cities. Shortest walk of the four, 1.7 km from the old town hall, now Museum Sloten: Lemsterpoort, Grutte Tsjerke, the working mill De Kaai, Kievit fountain. Free alley variant, or a €3 booklet.

locations.name: Sneek town walk
locations.description: Largest of the four, so the one with shops and cafés open on a winter day. The Waterpoort of about 1492 is the sight, Fortuna fountain behind it. €3 route from the museum, 2.5 to 3.5 km. Sunday parking paid 13:00 to 21:00

locations.name: Wintervaren, Sloep Events Friesland
locations.description: Two hours through the lakes in a covered heated sloop, skipper narrating as you go, finishing at dusk. €35 pp, Thu to Sun only at 14:00, so 2 or 3 Jan are the realistic days. Board at Waechswal, park at Lynbaen 15

locations.name: Zuiderzeelicht
locations.description: 90 min through the open-air Zuiderzee village lit up in the dark, the only way to see it in winter. Ends 3 Jan, shut 31 Dec and 1 Jan. Online ticket needed even with Museumkaart, and dates sell out. Free parking at Enkhuizerzand

locations.name: Fries Museum
locations.description: The history of Frisia itself. REDBAD, on the medieval Frisian kingdom, runs to 7 Feb 2027 with the Odin of Lejre on loan, plus a new permanent room on Leeuwarden native Mata Hari. €17.50, free with Museumkaart

locations.name: Elfstedenhal
locations.description: Full 400 m artificial oval open to recreational skaters, the reliable substitute when the natural ice never comes. €10.50 adult, €7.50 up to 17; skates €7.50, helmet €2.50, sizes 25 to 49

locations.name: Decemberlicht
locations.description: Free 1.5 km light route: fifteen facades with quotations, poems and light objects, 45 to 60 min, evenings. Follow the blue lantern light. Maps at the Visitor Center, walk starts at Kleine Kerkstraat

locations.name: Paviljoen 't Mar, Mirnser Klif
locations.description: Café on the clifftop with a panorama over the IJsselmeer, the Rijsterbos behind and a sandy beach below. The best kitespot on the east shore, water only 10 to 40 cm deep, so expect kiters. Free parking, open all year, late Fri to Sun

locations.name: Rijsterbos
locations.description: It Fryske Gea car park with an info board, start of a 7 km loop rated simple: stately lanes through the wood, then out along the beach past the Mirnser Klif. Narrow winding side paths for extra loops. Explicitly recommended as a winter walk

locations.name: Oudemirdumer Klif
locations.description: Six metre cliff over the IJsselmeer owned by Natuurmonumenten, with a public viewpoint, reached by the Minne Minnespad named after the last Zuiderzee fisherman of Oudemirdum. The damp soil carries over 200 plant species despite the modest height
